titles.head: The Kamo River
titles.text: On its east bank at Shijo stands the Minamiza, the city's kabuki theatre, rebuilt in 1929.

titles.eyebrow: Across the centre, into the sun
titles.head: A city that stays low
titles.text: 65,738 buildings, the median 8.4 m tall: only 65 of them reach above 45 m.

titles.head: Kyoto Tower
titles.text: 131 m to the spire, the deck at 100 m: a steel tube with no frame inside it, finished in 1964.

titles.head: Walk it
titles.text: Talk to the people who know the city, walk the quest to the Imperial Gardens, fly over the roofs.
